brief:
Gaza's death toll has reached 74,746 killed and 176,234 injured since the conflict began in October 2023, according to the Health Ministry, Eye on Palestine reported. The official count excludes thousands believed buried under rubble or uncounted in areas beyond ministry reach, with estimates of the true toll exceeding 100,000.

The territory faces a widening media gap as international coverage has diminished despite the ongoing humanitarian crisis. Observers note the documented toll continues to climb even as Gaza receives less journalistic attention than in the conflict's early months.
dek: Gaza is vanishing from the headlines, but the genocide has not ended. The Health Ministry's latest toll stands at 74,746 killed and 176,234 injured since October 2023, with the true toll estimated above 100,000.
title: Health Ministry reports 74,746 killed in Gaza since October 2023
